name: Avocado Toast with Everything Seasoning
description: Creamy avocado on toasted bread with everything bagel seasoning
instructions: Toast 2 slices of whole grain bread until golden and crisp. In a small bowl, mash 1/2 avocado with 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt, and pepper until mostly smooth but still slightly chunky. Spread mashed avocado evenly over toast. Sprinkle generously with everything bagel seasoning. For extra protein, top with 2 sliced hard-boiled eggs or smoked salmon. Garnish with red pepper flakes and fresh microgreens. Serve immediately.

name: Berry Protein Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick smoothie bowl topped with fresh fruits and granola
instructions: Add 1.5 scoops vanilla protein powder, 1 frozen banana, 1 cup mixed frozen berries, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, and 1/4 cup almond milk to a high-speed blender. Blend on high until thick and creamy, adding more almond milk if needed to achieve desired consistency. Pour into a bowl and arrange toppings in rows: 1/4 cup granola, 1/2 cup fresh berries, 1 tbsp chia seeds, 1 tbsp coconut flakes, and fresh mint leaves. Drizzle with 1 tsp honey if desired.

name: Blueberry Protein Muffins
description: Fluffy protein-packed muffins bursting with fresh blueberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners. In a large bowl, whisk together 2 cups almond flour, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp baking soda, and 1/4 tsp salt. In a separate bowl, mix 3 eggs, 1/4 cup melted coconut oil, 1/4 cup honey, and 1 cup almond milk. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Gently fold in 1 cup fresh blueberries. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups. Bake for 18-22 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool in tin for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: Scrambled eggs, black beans, and cheese in a whole wheat tortilla
instructions: Scramble eggs with black beans and cheese. Roll in tortilla with salsa and avocado.

name: Breakfast Quesadilla
description: Whole wheat tortilla with eggs, cheese, and black beans
instructions: Scramble eggs with cheese and beans. Spread on tortilla and fold. Cook until crispy.

name: Chia Seed Pudding
description: Creamy pudding made with chia seeds, milk, and protein powder
instructions: Mix chia seeds, milk, and protein powder. Refrigerate overnight. Top with fruits.

name: Chinese Congee with Chicken
description: Comforting Chinese rice porridge with shredded chicken
instructions: In a large pot, combine 1/2 cup jasmine rice, 6 cups chicken broth, and 1 tbsp fresh ginger (sliced). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down into a creamy porridge. Add 1 cup shredded cooked chicken, 2 tbsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Cook for 5 more minutes. Serve hot, topped with sliced green onions, fried shallots, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Chocolate Chip Protein Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with protein powder and dark chocolate chips
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 tsp salt. In another bowl, mix 1 cup buttermilk, 2 eggs, and 2 tbsp melted butter. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined (lumps are okay). Gently fold in 1/4 cup dark chocolate chips. Heat a griddle or non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease with butter or oil. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on surface and edges are set (2-3 minutes), then flip and cook until golden (1-2 minutes). Serve warm with maple syrup and fresh berries.

name: Cinnamon Roll Protein Oats
description: Warm oatmeal flavored like cinnamon rolls with protein powder
instructions: In a saucepan, combine 1 cup rolled oats, 1.5 cups almond milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, and 1/4 tsp nutmeg. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are creamy and tender. Remove from heat and stir in 1 tbsp maple syrup and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. Transfer to a bowl and top with 2 tbsp chopped pecans and 1 tbsp cream cheese frosting (mix 2 tbsp cream cheese with 1 tsp milk and 1/2 tsp maple syrup).

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
description: High-protein cottage cheese with fruits, nuts, and honey
instructions: Top cottage cheese with sliced fruits, nuts, and drizzle with honey.

name: Egg Muffins
description: Baked egg muffins with vegetables and cheese, perfect for meal prep
instructions: Whisk eggs with vegetables and cheese. Pour into muffin tin and bake until set.

name: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwich
description: Homemade breakfast sandwich with egg, cheese, and turkey
instructions: Toast 2 English muffin halves until golden. Heat 1 tsp butter in a small non-stick skillet over medium heat. Crack 2 eggs into the skillet and cook sunny-side up or over-easy to your preference. Place 1 slice of cheddar cheese on each English muffin half. Top one half with cooked eggs and 2 slices of turkey bacon. Season with salt and pepper. Close sandwich and serve immediately while eggs are still warm.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with fruits and high-fiber granola
instructions: In a clear glass or bowl, layer 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt on the bottom. Add a layer of mixed berries, followed by another layer of yogurt. Sprinkle high-fiber granola over the top. Drizzle honey evenly across the parfait. Serve chilled with a long spoon to enjoy all layers together.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Granola
description: Layered parfait with Greek yogurt, berries, and homemade granola
instructions: In a clear glass or bowl, layer 1/2 cup Greek yogurt on the bottom. Add a layer of 1/4 cup mixed berries. Sprinkle 2 tbsp high-protein granola over berries. Add another layer of Greek yogurt, followed by more berries and granola. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over the top. Garnish with fresh mint leaves if desired. Serve chilled with a long spoon to enjoy all layers together.

name: Japanese Miso Soup with Tofu
description: Traditional Japanese breakfast soup with silken tofu and seaweed
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 3 cups dashi or vegetable broth to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and add 3 tbsp white miso paste, whisking until dissolved. Add 4 oz cubed silken tofu, 1/4 cup dried wakame seaweed (rehydrated), and 1/2 cup sliced green onions. Simmer for 2 minutes until tofu is warmed through. Serve immediately in bowls, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Matcha Green Tea Smoothie
description: Antioxidant-rich smoothie with matcha and protein
instructions: In a blender, combine 1 tsp matcha green tea powder, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 frozen banana, 1 cup almond milk, and 1 tbsp honey. Add 1/2 cup ice cubes. Blend on high speed for 60-90 seconds until completely smooth and vibrant green. The matcha provides antioxidants and a gentle caffeine boost, while protein powder supports muscle maintenance. Pour into a glass and garnish with a sprinkle of matcha powder if desired.

name: Overnight Protein Oats
description: No-cook oatmeal soaked overnight with protein powder and fruits
instructions: In a mason jar or container, combine rolled oats, protein powder, milk, and chia seeds. Stir well until protein powder is fully dissolved. Cover and refrigerate overnight for at least 8 hours. In the morning, stir well and top with fresh berries and chopped walnuts. Can be eaten cold or warmed in the microwave for 30 seconds.

name: Portuguese Sweet Rice Porridge
description: Creamy Portuguese rice pudding with cinnamon and lemon
instructions: In a saucepan, combine 1/2 cup arborio rice, 1.5 cups milk, 1/2 cup water, 1 cinnamon stick, and 1 strip lemon zest. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender and creamy. Remove cinnamon stick and lemon zest. Stir in 2 tbsp honey and 1/4 tsp vanilla extract. Serve warm, sprinkled with ground cinnamon and topped with fresh berries if desired.

name: Protein Breakfast Bowl
description: Nutrient-dense bowl with quinoa, fruits, and nuts
instructions: Cook 1/2 cup quinoa according to package directions and let cool slightly. In a bowl, combine cooked quinoa, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup mixed berries, 1 tbsp chopped almonds, and 1 tbsp chia seeds. Drizzle with 1 tbsp maple syrup and sprinkle with cinnamon. For extra protein, add 1 scoop vanilla protein powder to the Greek yogurt before mixing. This balanced breakfast provides complex carbs, protein, and healthy fats for sustained energy.

name: Protein Breakfast Burrito Bowl
description: Deconstructed burrito bowl with eggs, black beans, and avocado
instructions: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add 1/2 cup diced bell pepper and 1/4 cup diced onion, sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add 1/2 cup black beans and heat through. Meanwhile, whisk 3 eggs with 2 tbsp milk and scramble in the same skillet until just set. In a bowl, layer cooked brown rice, scrambled eggs, black bean mixture, 1/4 cup salsa, and 1/4 sliced avocado. Top with 2 tbsp shredded cheese, 1 tbsp sour cream, and fresh cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Protein Breakfast Cookies
description: Soft, chewy cookies packed with protein and oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a large bowl, mix 1.5 cups rolled oats, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1/2 cup almond flour, 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp cinnamon, and 1/4 tsp salt. In another bowl, whisk 1/4 cup melted coconut oil, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 egg, and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until combined. Fold in 1/4 cup dark chocolate chips and 2 tbsp chopped walnuts. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Flatten slightly with fingers. Bake for 12-15 minutes until edges are golden but centers are still soft. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

name: Protein Coffee Smoothie
description: Coffee-flavored protein smoothie for morning energy
instructions: Brew 1 cup strong coffee and let cool completely. Add cooled coffee, 1 frozen banana, 1 scoop chocolate protein powder, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1 cup almond milk, and 1 tsp vanilla extract to a blender. Add a handful of ice cubes. Blend on high speed for 60-90 seconds until completely smooth and creamy. The coffee provides caffeine for energy, while protein powder supports muscle maintenance. Pour into a tall glass and enjoy immediately for a quick breakfast on the go.

name: Protein Hot Chocolate
description: Warm, comforting hot chocolate with protein powder
instructions: Heat 1.5 cups milk in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm but not boiling. Remove from heat and whisk in 1 scoop chocolate protein powder and 1 tbsp cocoa powder until completely dissolved. Add 1 tsp vanilla extract and 1/2 tsp cinnamon. Return to low heat and whisk for 1 minute until warm and frothy. Pour into a mug and top with mini marshmallows or whipped cream if desired. Serve immediately while warm.

name: Protein Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with protein powder and topped with berries
instructions: Mix protein powder with pancake mix. Cook pancakes and top with berries and maple syrup.

name: Protein Power Oatmeal
description: Hearty oatmeal packed with protein and fiber for sustained energy
instructions: Combine rolled oats and 1 cup of water or milk in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2-3 minutes until oats are cooked and creamy (or cook on stovetop for 5 minutes). Stir in protein powder, mixing well to combine. Add chia seeds and stir for 1 minute until they absorb some liquid. Top with fresh berries and chopped nuts. Serve immediately while warm.

name: Protein Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick protein smoothie topped with nutritious seeds and fruits
instructions: Add frozen banana, protein powder, spinach, almond butter, and 1/2 cup of milk to a high-speed blender. Blend for 1-2 minutes until completely smooth and thick. Pour the smoothie into a bowl. Top with granola, flax seeds, and fresh berries. Serve immediately while the smoothie is still cold and thick.

name: Protein Waffle Sandwich
description: Crispy protein waffles filled with Greek yogurt and berries
instructions: Preheat waffle iron. In a bowl, mix 1 cup oat flour, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/4 tsp salt. In another bowl, whisk 2 eggs, 3/4 cup almond milk, and 2 tbsp melted coconut oil. Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until just mixed. Pour batter into waffle iron and cook according to manufacturer instructions until golden and crisp. Repeat to make 2 waffles. Let waffles cool slightly, then spread 1/2 cup Greek yogurt on one waffle, top with 1/2 cup mixed berries, and place second waffle on top to create a sandwich.

name: Pumpkin Spice Protein Oatmeal
description: Fall-inspired oatmeal with pumpkin and warming spices
instructions: In a saucepan, combine 1 cup rolled oats, 1.5 cups almond milk, 1/2 cup pumpkin purée, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 tsp pumpkin pie spice, and 1 tbsp maple syrup. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are creamy and tender. Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. Transfer to a bowl and top with 2 tbsp toasted pecans and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast Skillet
description: Hearty skillet with sausage, eggs, and potatoes
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 cup diced frozen hash browns and cook for 5-6 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring occasionally. Push potatoes to one side of the skillet. Add 4 oz breakfast sausage and cook, breaking it up, until browned (4-5 minutes. Create 2 wells in the potato-sausage mixture and crack 1 egg into each well. Cover skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny. Season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle with 1/4 cup shredded cheddar cheese and serve directly from the skillet.

name: Savory Breakfast Quinoa
description: Nutritious quinoa cooked with vegetables and topped with a poached egg
instructions: Rinse 1/2 cup quinoa thoroughly. In a saucepan, heat 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat. Add 1/4 cup diced onion and 1 clove minced garlic, sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Add rinsed quinoa and 1 cup vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until quinoa is tender and liquid is absorbed. Stir in 1 cup chopped spinach and cook until wilted (1 minute). Season with salt and pepper. Transfer to bowls and top with poached eggs, sliced avocado, and red pepper flakes.

name: Savory Oatmeal Bowl
description: Savory oatmeal topped with egg, cheese, and vegetables
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 cup water or vegetable broth to a boil. Add 1/2 cup rolled oats and reduce heat to medium-low. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are tender and creamy. Stir in 1 tbsp nutritional yeast, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Transfer to a bowl and top with a fried egg, 2 oz shredded cheddar cheese, sautéed mushrooms, and fresh chives. The savory flavors make this a satisfying alternative to sweet oatmeal.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: Classic bagel with smoked salmon, cream cheese, and capers
instructions: Toast 1 whole grain bagel until golden and crisp. Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese evenly on both halves. Layer 3 oz smoked salmon on one half. Top with thinly sliced red onion, 1 tbsp capers, and fresh dill sprigs. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over salmon. Season with black pepper. Close sandwich and cut in half. Serve immediately while bagel is still warm.

name: Spanish Tortilla with Chorizo
description: Traditional Spanish potato omelet with chorizo
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add 1 cup thinly sliced potatoes and cook for 8-10 minutes until tender. Add 1/2 cup sliced Spanish chorizo and 1/4 cup diced onion, cook for 3 minutes. In a bowl, beat 4 eggs with salt and pepper. Pour egg mixture over potatoes in skillet. Cook for 4-5 minutes, gently lifting edges to let uncooked egg flow underneath. Place a plate over skillet and carefully flip tortilla onto plate. Slide back into skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes more. Slide onto serving plate and let rest for 5 minutes before cutting into wedges.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette filled with spinach, feta cheese, and tomatoes
instructions: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add 2 cups fresh spinach and cook until wilted (1-2 minutes). Remove spinach and set aside. In a bowl, whisk 4 eggs with 2 tbsp milk, salt, and pepper. Pour eggs into the same skillet and cook, gently pushing cooked portions toward center and tilting pan to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath (2-3 minutes). When eggs are mostly set but still slightly moist on top, sprinkle wilted spinach, 2 oz crumbled feta cheese, and 1/4 cup diced tomatoes over one half. Fold other half over filling and cook for 1 more minute. Slide onto plate and serve immediately.

name: Tofu Scramble
description: Plant-based scrambled tofu with vegetables and turmeric
instructions: Crumble tofu and sauté with vegetables, turmeric, and nutritional yeast.

name: Veggie Scramble Wrap
description: Fluffy eggs with vegetables and cheese wrapped in a whole grain tortilla
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat with a little oil or cooking spray. Crack 3 eggs into the pan, add a splash of milk or water, and whisk lightly. Add spinach, diced bell pepper, and onion. Scramble with a spatula for 3-4 minutes until eggs are set but still moist. Stir in shredded cheese and remove from heat. Warm the tortilla for 10 seconds in a dry pan or microwave. Scoop the egg mixture into the center of the tortilla, add sliced avocado, and roll tightly from one side to the other. Cut in half diagonally before serving.

name: Alentejan Pork with Clams
description: Traditional Portuguese pork and clam dish
instructions: Marinate 1 lb pork shoulder in 4 cloves garlic, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 cup white wine, and 2 tbsp olive oil for 2 hours. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan and cook pork until browned. Add 1 lb small clams, 2 cups potatoes, and 1/2 cup coriander. Cover and cook for 10 minutes until clams open. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Anti-inflammatory Beef Stir-Fry with Ginger
description: Lean beef with ginger and broccoli in turmeric-infused sauce
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornstarch, turmeric, and 1 tablespoon water for the sauce. Heat a wok over high heat with oil. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Add sliced ginger, garlic, and broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 3 minutes until broccoli is bright green. Return beef to the wok. Pour in sauce and toss everything together. Simmer for 2 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Anti-inflammatory Chicken Curry
description: Healing turmeric-rich curry with chicken, spinach, and coconut milk
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onions and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and turmeric, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides (5-7 minutes). Pour in coconut milk and add diced tomatoes. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes. Add spinach and cook for 3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over basmati rice.

name: Argentine Chimichurri Steak
description: Grilled steak with fresh chimichurri sauce
instructions: Grill steak to desired doneness. Let rest. Make chimichurri with parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, and oregano. Slice steak and top generously with sauce.

name: Asturian Fabada with Chorizo
description: Hearty Spanish bean stew with chorizo and morcilla
instructions: Soak 1 lb white fabada beans overnight. Drain and place in a large pot with 8 cups water. Add 1/2 lb Spanish chorizo, 1/4 lb morcilla (blood sausage), 1/4 lb pork belly, and 1 saffron thread. Simmer for 2-3 hours until beans are tender. Add salt to taste. Serve hot in bowls with crusty bread.

name: Baked Ziti
description: Ziti pasta with meat sauce and cheese baked until bubbly
instructions: Cook ziti and mix with meat sauce and cheese. Bake until golden and bubbly.

name: Beef Lasagna
description: Layers of pasta, meat sauce, and cheese baked to perfection
instructions: Layer pasta with meat sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly and golden.

name: Beef Pepper Stir-Fry
description: Colorful beef stir-fry with bell peppers and anti-inflammatory ginger
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Add sliced bell peppers (red, yellow, and green), julienned carrots, and broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return beef to wok. Pour in sauce mixture (soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon honey). Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until sauce coats everything. Sprinkle with green onions and serve immediately over jasmine rice.
ingredients: 6 oz beef sirloin or flank steak

name: Beef Short Ribs
description: Slow-braised beef short ribs with red wine reduction
instructions: Sear short ribs on all sides. Sauté vegetables. Deglaze with red wine. Add beef and slow cook for 3-4 hours until fork-tender. Finish with fresh herbs.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Tender beef strips in creamy mushroom sauce over noodles
instructions: Sauté beef with mushrooms. Add cream sauce and serve over egg noodles.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef tacos with all the fixings
instructions: Brown beef with taco seasoning. Serve in tortillas with cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.

name: Beef Wellington
description: Tender beef fillet wrapped in puff pastry with mushrooms
instructions: Sear beef fillet. Sauté mushrooms to make duxelles. Wrap beef in prosciutto, mushrooms, and pastry. Bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until golden.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Classic Chinese takeout made healthy at home
instructions: Slice 1 lb beef sirloin into thin strips against the grain. In a bowl, toss beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Add 1 tbsp oil to wok, add 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add 4 cups broccoli florets and 1 sliced red bell pepper, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender. Return beef to wok with sauce mixture (2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil). Toss for 1 minute. Serve over brown rice.

name: Beef and Cabbage Stir-Fry
description: Quick and healthy beef with cabbage, ginger, and bell peppers
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain into 1/4-inch strips. Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water in a small bowl, add beef strips and toss to coat evenly. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until no longer pink. Remove beef and set aside. Add sliced onion and bell peppers (red, yellow, green). Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 2 minutes until wilted but still has some crunch. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon turmeric. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return beef to the wok. Pour in sauce mixture (3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, and 1 teaspoon sesame oil). Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until sauce coats everything. Remove from heat, stir in sesame seeds and sliced green onions. Serve immediately over jasmine rice.
ingredients: 6 oz beef sirloin or flank steak

name: Beef and Vegetable Stew with Turmeric
description: Hearty beef stew with root vegetables and anti-inflammatory spices
instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides (5-7 minutes). Remove beef and set aside. Add diced onion, carrots, celery, and garlic to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add tomato paste, turmeric, paprika, and stir for 1 minute. Return beef to pot along with beef broth and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes. Add cubed potatoes and parsnips, continue simmering for 30 more minutes until beef and vegetables are tender. Add fresh thyme and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.
ingredients: 8 oz beef chuck or stew meat

name: Beef with Root Vegetables
description: Slow-cooked beef with hearty root vegetables and herbs
instructions: Cut beef into 2-inch cubes. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides (5-6 minutes). Remove beef and set aside. Add diced onions, carrots, celery root, and turnips to the pot. Cook for 6-7 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Add minced garlic, tomato paste, and 1 tablespoon turmeric. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Return beef to the pot along with beef broth and bay leaves. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours until beef is tender. Add cubed potatoes and cook for 30 more minutes. Remove bay leaves, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Bowl
description: Plant-based power bowl with black beans and roasted sweet potato
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes. Serve with black beans, corn, avocado, and lime-cilantro dressing.

name: Braised Chicken with Root Vegetables
description: Slow-braised chicken with carrots, parsnips, and aromatic herbs
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into serving pieces (bone-in or bone-out). Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces, skin-side down, and cook for 5-6 minutes until golden brown. Flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes until browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion, carrots, and parsnips to the pot. Cook for 6-7 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Add tomato paste, 2 tablespoons turmeric, minced garlic, and fresh thyme. Stir for 2 minutes until fragrant. Pour in 2 cups chicken broth and 1/2 cup white wine (or additional broth). Return chicken to the pot. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 45-55 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are cooked. Remove chicken and vegetables, increase heat to high, and simmer cooking liquid for 5-8 minutes until reduced by half. Season with salt and pepper. Serve chicken and vegetables with the reduced sauce spooned over top. Serve with boiled potatoes or crusty bread.

name: Braised Lamb Shanks
description: Tender lamb shanks braised in red wine
instructions: Brown lamb shanks. Sauté vegetables. Deglaze with red wine. Add broth and herbs. Braise at 325°F for 2-3 hours until fork-tender.

name: Braised Short Ribs
description: Tender short ribs in red wine and herb reduction
instructions: Brown short ribs thoroughly. Sauté vegetables. Deglaze with red wine. Add beef broth and herbs. Braise for 3-4 hours until fork-tender.

name: British Beef Wellington
description: Beef fillet wrapped in puff pastry
instructions: Sear beef fillet. Sauté mushrooms to make duxelles. Wrap beef in prosciutto, mushrooms, and puff pastry. Bake until golden.

name: Chicken Cabbage Bowl
description: Asian-inspired bowl with chicken, cabbage, and turmeric
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water, toss chicken to coat. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Add chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until lightly browned. Remove chicken and set aside. Add sliced cabbage (green and red), julienned carrots, and shredded broccoli stems. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cabbage is wilted but still crunchy. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon turmeric, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return chicken to wok. Pour in sauce mixture (soy sauce, rice vinegar, and 1 teaspoon honey). Toss everything together for 1 minute until coated. Remove from heat, stir in green onions, and serve over jasmine rice.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Rolled tortillas with chicken, cheese, and enchilada sauce
instructions: Roll chicken and cheese in tortillas. Top with sauce and bake until bubbly.

name: Chicken Garlic Ginger Roast
description: Whole roasted chicken with garlic, ginger, and seasonal vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Remove giblets and pat chicken dry. Rub 3 tablespoons softened butter all over the chicken. Mix minced garlic, grated ginger, 1 tablespoon paprika, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Rub this mixture under the chicken skin and over the breast. Stuff cavity with lemon wedges, thyme sprigs, and remaining garlic cloves. Truss legs with kitchen twine. Place chicken on a roasting pan, add 1 cup water to prevent burning. Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes (20 minutes per pound) until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part of the thigh. Let rest for 15 minutes before carving. Serve with pan juices and roasted root vegetables.

name: Chicken Lemon Herb Bake
description: Baked chicken with lemon, herbs, and roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut root vegetables into 1-inch chunks: carrots, parsnips, and red onions. Toss vegetables with 2 tablespoons olive oil, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet. Pat chicken breasts dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Rub chicken with 1 tablespoon olive oil, then sprinkle with dried oregano and lemon zest. Place chicken on top of vegetables. Bake for 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through (165°F/74°C internal) and vegetables are tender. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Squeeze fresh lemon over everything before serving. Serve with boiled potatoes or over rice.

name: Chicken Parmesan
description: Breaded chicken breast with marinara sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Set up 3 shallow bowls: one with flour, one with 2 beaten eggs, and one with breadcrumbs mixed with 1/4 cup parmesan. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Dredge each chicken breast in flour, shaking off excess. Dip into eggs, letting excess drip off. Press into breadcrumb-parmesan mixture, coating well. Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. In the same pan (without cleaning), pour marinara sauce and bring to a simmer. Arrange chicken back in the pan, spoon sauce over the top. Sprinkle remaining parmesan and mozzarella over chicken. Transfer to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Serve chicken and sauce over pasta with extra parmesan.

name: Chicken Sweet Potato Curry
description: Creamy curry with chicken, sweet potatoes, and healing spices
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, and coriander. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides (6-7 minutes). Pour in coconut milk and add diced sweet potatoes. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Add peas and spinach, cook for 3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve over basmati rice with a squeeze of lime.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender chicken in creamy tomato sauce with basmati rice
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken. Make creamy tomato sauce. Simmer chicken in sauce. Serve with rice.

name: Chicken Turmeric Stir-Fry
description: Quick and healthy chicken with turmeric, ginger, and colorful vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken into strips. Mix turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper. Coat chicken with the spice mixture. Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat with coconut oil. Add chicken and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside. Add sliced bell peppers, broccoli, and snap peas to pan. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Return chicken to the pan. Add minced garlic, ginger, and soy sauce. Toss everything together for 1 minute. Serve with brown rice.

name: Chicken Turmeric Vegetable Skillet
description: One-pan chicken with turmeric, bell peppers, and sweet potatoes
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon turmeric. Add chicken to skillet, skin-side down, and cook for 6-7 minutes until golden. Flip and cook for another 5 minutes. Remove chicken and set aside. Reduce heat to medium, add diced onion and bell peppers. Cook for 4-5 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic, ginger, and 1 teaspoon turmeric, stirring for 1 minute. Add diced tomatoes and sweet potato cubes. Cover and cook for 10-12 minutes until potatoes are tender. Return chicken to pan, add spinach, and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Serve hot with crusty bread or over rice.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup with Turmeric
description: Comforting chicken soup with root vegetables and healing turmeric
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 5-6 minutes until lightly browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. Add diced onion, carrots, celery, and leek to the pot. Cook for 6-7 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, 2 tablespoons turmeric, and dried thyme. Stir for 2 minutes until fragrant. Return chicken to the pot. Pour in 6 cups chicken broth and add 2 bay leaves. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 35-40 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are soft. Remove bay leaves. Add cubed potatoes and cook for 15-20 minutes until tender. Stir in fresh parsley and season with salt and pepper. Serve hot, optionally with a drizzle of olive oil and crusty bread on the side.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
description: Comforting chicken stew with fluffy dumplings
instructions: Simmer chicken with vegetables. Drop dumpling batter on top and cook until fluffy.

name: Chicken and Roasted Vegetable Bowl
description: Nutritious bowl with roasted chicken and seasonal vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut mixed vegetables into uniform pieces: broccoli florets, cauliflower florets, Brussels sprouts, and carrot rounds. Toss vegetables with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper. Spread on a large baking sheet. Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon paprika. Place chicken on baking sheet alongside vegetables. Roast for 25-30 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally and vegetables are tender and golden at edges. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice. Divide quinoa or brown rice into bowls. Top with sliced chicken, roasted vegetables, and a drizzle of tahini dressing. Garnish with fresh parsley.
ingredients: 1 cup cooked quinoa or brown rice

name: Chicken and Vegetable Curry Stew
description: Aromatic curry-style chicken stew with root vegetables and turmeric
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 6-8 minutes until lightly browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. In the same pot, add diced onion, carrots, celery root, and cubed sweet potatoes. Cook for 6-7 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, and coriander. Stir for 2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in 2 tablespoons tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Return chicken to the pot. Pour in coconut milk and 2 cups chicken broth. Add bay leaves and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 40-45 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are cooked. Remove bay leaves. Stir in fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot over basmati rice or with naan bread.
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or naan bread

name: Chicken and Vegetable Skewers
description: Grilled chicken and vegetable skewers with quinoa
instructions: Preheat grill or oven to 400°F (200°C). If using wooden skewers, soak in water for 30 minutes. Cut chicken and vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Thread chicken and vegetables onto skewers, alternating ingredients for even cooking. Brush with olive oil and season with herbs and lemon. Grill for 8-10 minutes per side (or bake for 20-25 minutes), turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C) and vegetables are charred at edges. Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes. Serve with cooked quinoa and lemon wedges.

name: Chinese Peking Duck
description: Crispy roast duck with hoisin and pancakes
instructions: Roast duck until skin is crispy. Slice thinly. Serve with thin pancakes, hoisin sauce, scallion brushes, and cucumber slices.

name: Chinese Peking Roast Duck
description: Traditional roast duck with crispy skin
instructions: Air-dry duck. Glaze with maltose syrup. Roast until skin is crispy. Slice thinly. Serve with pancakes, scallions, and hoisin.

name: Chinese Peking Style Braised Pork
description: Braised pork belly in soy and five-spice
instructions: Braise pork belly in mixture of soy sauce, five-spice, rock sugar, and aromatics. Cook slowly for 2-3 hours until gelatinous.

name: Chinese Steamed Fish
description: Whole white fish steamed with ginger and scallions
instructions: Season fish with salt. Steam over high heat. Heat oil and pour over fish with soy sauce, ginger, and scallions. Serve immediately.

name: Coconut Curry with Tofu
description: Creamy Thai curry with tofu and vegetables
instructions: Press 1 block firm tofu to remove excess water, then cut into 1-inch cubes. Heat 1 tbsp coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add 1 diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger, cook for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp red curry paste and cook for 30 seconds. Add 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk, 1 cup vegetable broth, 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, snap peas), and tofu cubes. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Season with soy sauce and lime juice. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Coconut Shrimp
description: Breaded shrimp with coconut coating served with mango salsa
instructions: Bread shrimp with coconut. Fry until golden. Serve with mango salsa and rice.

name: Cod with Garlic and Herbs
description: Baked cod with garlic, herbs, and lemon served with roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat cod fillets dry and season with salt and pepper. Mix minced garlic, chopped parsley, lemon zest, olive oil, and oregano in a small bowl. Coat each cod fillet with garlic-herb mixture. Place cod on a baking sheet. Arrange chopped carrots, zucchini, and red onion around fish. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15-18 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily. Squeeze fresh lemon over fish before serving.

name: Cod with Lemon and Dill
description: Light and flaky cod baked with lemon and fresh dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat cod fillets dry with paper towels. Place cod on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle each fillet with olive oil and lemon juice. Season generously with salt and pepper. Top with thin lemon slices and fresh dill. Scatter cherry tomatoes and asparagus around fish. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt. Bake for 12-15 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily. Serve with boiled potatoes or crusty bread.

name: Cod with Roasted Vegetables
description: Dutch-style cod with seasonal root vegetables and herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut carrots, parsnips, and potatoes into 1-inch chunks. Toss vegetables with olive oil, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Spread vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes. Place cod fillets on baking sheet with vegetables. Brush cod with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and lemon zest. Roast for another 12-15 minutes until cod is opaque and vegetables are tender. Drizzle with lemon juice before serving.

name: Cordoban Salmorejo with Jamón
description: Creamy cold tomato soup with Spanish ham
instructions: In a blender, combine 2 lbs ripe tomatoes, 1/2 cup stale bread, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, and 1 tsp sherry vinegar. Blend until completely smooth. Season with salt. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve in shallow bowls topped with diced serrano ham, hard-boiled eggs, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Duck Breast with Cherry Sauce
description: Pan-seared duck breast with tart cherry reduction
instructions: Score duck skin and sear skin-side down until crispy. Flip and cook to medium-rare. Make cherry sauce in same pan. Slice and serve with sauce.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Breaded eggplant with marinara sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Bread and fry eggplant slices. Layer with sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Creamy pasta with parmesan sauce and grilled chicken
instructions: Cook fettuccine. Make cream sauce with butter, cream, and parmesan. Toss with chicken.

name: Filipino Adobo with Chicken
description: Tangy Filipino chicken stewed in soy and vinegar
instructions: In a pot, combine 1 lb chicken pieces, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup water, 4 cloves garlic, 1 bay leaf, and 1 tsp black peppercorns. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken and fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden. Return to pot and simmer for 10 more minutes until sauce reduces and thickens. Serve over steamed rice.

name: Fish and Chips
description: Beer-battered cod with crispy fries and tartar sauce
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch thick sticks and soak in cold water for 15 minutes, then drain and pat completely dry. Heat oil in a deep fryer or large pot to 350°F (175°C). While oil heats, prepare batter by whisking beer with flour and salt until smooth (batter should be thick enough to coat the back of a spoon). Dust cod fillets in a light coating of flour, shaking off excess. Dip into beer batter, coating evenly. Fry potatoes in batches for 5-6 minutes until golden and crispy. Remove and drain on paper towels, season with salt. Fry cod in batches for 4-5 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove and drain on paper towels, season with salt. Serve fish and chips with tartar sauce, lemon wedges, and malt vinegar.

name: French Cassoulet
description: Slow-cooked bean casserole with meats
instructions: Cook beans with pork skin. Sauté meats and vegetables. Layer with beans. Bake for hours until crust forms. Break crust several times.

name: French Coq au Vin
description: Chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms
instructions: Brown chicken pieces. Sauté lardons and vegetables. Deglaze with red wine. Add chicken and simmer until tender. Garnish with pearl onions and mushrooms.

name: French Duck Confit
description: Slow-cooked duck leg in its own fat
instructions: Salt duck legs and refrigerate overnight. Slow cook in duck fat at 300°F for 3 hours until fork-tender. Crisp skin under broiler.

name: German Sauerbraten
description: Marinated pot roast with sweet-sour gravy
instructions: Marinate beef in vinegar and spices for 3-4 days. Brown beef and simmer in marinade until tender. Add gingersnaps to thicken sauce.

name: Greek Pastitsio
description: Greek lasagna with beef and creamy béchamel
instructions: Layer pasta, spiced beef sauce, and béchamel. Top with cheese. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes until golden and bubbly.

name: Greek Stifado
description: Beef stew with pearl onions and red wine
instructions: Brown beef chunks. Sauté pearl onions. Add tomato paste, red wine, and spices. Simmer slowly for 2-3 hours. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Grilled Branzino
description: Whole Mediterranean fish with lemon and herbs
instructions: Score fish and stuff with lemon slices and herbs. Grill over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes per side. Drizzle with olive oil and serve with roasted potatoes.

name: Grilled Pork Tenderloin
description: Juicy grilled pork tenderloin with apple glaze and roasted vegetables
instructions: Trim 8 oz pork tenderloin of excess fat and silver skin. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 minced garlic clove, salt, and pepper to make marinade. Place pork in a resealable bag with marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours). Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove pork from marinade and grill for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until internal temperature reaches 145°F. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Meanwhile, toss 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, zucchini) with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Grill vegetables for 8-10 minutes until tender and charred. Serve sliced pork with grilled vegetables.

name: Ground Beef Ginger Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Quick and healthy ground beef with broccoli, ginger, and garlic
instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (5-6 minutes). Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and sliced onion. Stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add broccoli florets and continue stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until bright green but still crisp. Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil in a small bowl. Pour sauce over beef and vegetables, tossing to coat evenly. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat, stir in sesame seeds, and serve immediately over jasmine rice.

name: Ground Beef Shepherd's Pie
description: Comforting shepherd's pie with ground beef, root vegetables, and mashed potato topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6-8 minutes). Drain excess fat. Add diced onion, carrots, and celery. Cook for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic, thyme, and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir for 1 minute. Add frozen peas and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in 2 tablespoons flour and cook for 1 minute. Pour in 1 cup beef broth and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Meanwhile, boil cubed potatoes in salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with butter, salt, and pepper. Transfer beef mixture to a baking dish. Spread mashed potatoes evenly over the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes until filling is bubbly and topping is golden. Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Ground Beef Turmeric Bowls
description: Anti-inflammatory ground beef seasoned with turmeric and ginger served over vegetables
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (7 minutes). Add diced onions and cook for 4 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, and cinnamon. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes and water. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes until sauce thickens. Meanwhile, steam broccoli and carrots until tender-crisp. Divide vegetables into bowls and top with beef mixture. Garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Ground Beef and Green Bean Chili
description: Hearty anti-inflammatory chili with ground beef, green beans, and warming spices
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6-8 minutes). Drain excess fat if needed. Add diced onion, bell peppers, and garlic. Cook for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add 1 tablespoon chili powder, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, and 1 tablespoon turmeric. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes with their juices. Cook for 5 minutes, breaking up tomatoes with a spoon. Pour in 3 cups beef broth and 1 can (14 oz) diced tomatoes. Add 2 cans (15 oz each) green beans, drained and rinsed. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45-60 minutes until flavors develop and chili thickens slightly. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot with toppings such as shredded cheese, diced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime. Accompany with brown rice or cornbread.

name: Ground Beef and Vegetable Bibimbap
description: Korean-inspired rice bowl with seasoned ground beef and sautéed vegetables
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package instructions. For the beef: heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, breaking it up. Cook until browned (5-6 minutes). Add minced garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar. Stir for 2 minutes and set aside. Sauté spinach with sesame oil and salt until wilted (2 minutes). In separate pans, quickly sauté julienned carrots and zucchini with a little oil and salt. Arrange rice in a bowl. Top with beef, spinach, carrots, zucchini, and a fried egg. Serve with gochujang on the side.

name: Ground Beef with Kale and Garlic
description: Healthy ground beef with nutrient-dense kale and garlic
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6-7 minutes). Drain excess fat if needed. Add diced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic and grated ginger, stirring for 1 minute until fragrant. Add chopped kale in batches, stirring until wilted (about 3 minutes total). Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes to develop flavors. Serve over brown rice or with whole grain bread.

name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets with sweet honey garlic glaze
instructions: Mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce. Glaze salmon. Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes. Broil for 2 minutes to caramelize. Serve with steamed vegetables.

name: Indian Butter Chicken
description: Creamy tomato-based curry with tender chicken
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken. Make sauce with tomatoes, cream, garam masala, and butter. Add chicken and simmer. Serve with naan and rice.

name: Indian Hyderabadi Biryani
description: Layered rice with spiced meat and saffron
instructions: Marinate meat in yogurt and spices. Cook half-done rice. Layer meat and rice. Add saffron milk. Steam until done.

name: Indian Rogan Josh
description: Kashmiri lamb curry with aromatic spices
instructions: Brown lamb pieces. Add yogurt and aromatic spices including cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves. Slow cook until tender. Finish with garam masala.

name: Italian Cacciatora Chicken
description: Hunter-style chicken braised with tomatoes and herbs
instructions: Brown chicken pieces. Sauté onions and garlic. Add tomatoes, wine, and herbs. Simmer until chicken is cooked through.

name: Italian Osso Buco
description: Braised veal shanks with gremolata
instructions: Brown veal shanks. Sauté vegetables. Add wine and broth. Simmer covered for 2-3 hours until meat is tender. Top with gremolata of lemon, garlic, and parsley.

name: Italian Porchetta
description: Slow-roasted herb-stuffed pork roast
instructions: Butterfly pork loin. Stuff with garlic, rosemary, and fennel. Roll and tie. Slow roast until internal temp reaches 145°F.

name: Jamaican Oxtail Stew
description: Slow-cooked oxtail with Jamaican spices and beans
instructions: Brown oxtail pieces. Add onions, garlic, scallions, and Jamaican spices. Add water and simmer for 3-4 hours. Add butter beans and cook until thickened.

name: Japanese Kaiseki Feast
description: Multi-course traditional Japanese meal
instructions: Prepare multiple small dishes: sashimi, simmered vegetables, grilled fish, rice, miso soup, and pickled vegetables. Arrange artistically.

name: Japanese Oyakodon
description: Chicken and egg rice bowl with dashi broth
instructions: Simmer chicken in dashi with onions and soy sauce. Beat eggs and pour over chicken. Cover until eggs are set. Serve over rice.

name: Japanese Sukiyaki Hot Pot
description: Beef and vegetables simmered in sweet soy broth
instructions: Heat sukiyaki pot with oil. Brown beef slices. Add vegetables, tofu, and shirataki noodles. Add warishita sauce and simmer at table.

name: Japanese Tonkatsu with Curry
description: Breaded pork cutlet with Japanese curry rice
instructions: Bread and fry pork until golden. Prepare Japanese curry roux with vegetables and beef broth. Serve pork over curry rice with pickled vegetables.

name: Korean BBQ Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in sweet and savory Korean-style sauce
instructions: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. Mix soy sauce, grated pear (for tenderness), minced garlic, sesame oil, brown sugar, black pepper, and grated onion to make marinade. Add chicken to marinade, ensuring pieces are coated. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Thread chicken onto soaked wooden skewers. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and charred on edges. Brush with remaining marinade while grilling. Serve with steamed rice and extra sauce.

name: Korean Bibimbap with Beef
description: Korean rice bowl with seasoned beef, fresh vegetables, gochujang sauce, and a fried egg
instructions: Prepare steamed jasmine rice. Thinly slice beef and marinate in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar for 15 minutes. Stir-fry beef until browned (4-5 minutes). Blanch spinach, julienne carrots, zucchini, and cucumber. Steam bean sprouts. Sauté each vegetable separately with sesame oil and salt. Arrange rice in a bowl, top with beef, vegetables, and a fried egg. Serve with gochujang sauce on side. Mix everything together before eating.

name: Korean Braised Ribs
description: Tender short ribs in soy-ginger glaze
instructions: Brown short ribs. Add soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and water. Braise for 3 hours until meat falls off bone. Reduce sauce until glossy.

name: Korean Dakgalbi
description: Spicy stir-fried chicken with rice cakes
instructions: Marinate chicken in gochujang sauce. Stir-fry with vegetables and rice cakes. Add cabbage and cook until tender. Top with sesame seeds.

name: Korean Galbi Jjim
description: Braised short ribs in soy garlic sauce
instructions: Brown short ribs. Add soy sauce, garlic, sugar, and water. Braise for 2-3 hours until tender. Add vegetables and cook until done. Garnish with sesame seeds.

name: Korean Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Spicy and tangy fried rice with kimchi, pork, and egg
instructions: Cook jasmine rice and refrigerate for at least 2 hours (or use leftover rice). Heat a wok or large skillet over high heat with sesame oil. Add minced pork and cook until browned (5 minutes). Add chopped kimchi and stir-fry for 3 minutes until fragrant. Add rice and break up any clumps. Drizzle with gochujang and soy sauce, stirring constantly to coat evenly. Make a well in the center, crack an egg, and scramble into the rice. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Serve immediately.
ingredients: 4 oz pork belly or shoulder, minced

name: Korean Kimchi Soup with Tofu
description: Light and comforting soup with kimchi, tofu, and mushrooms
instructions: Slice tofu into 1-inch cubes. Cut kimchi into bite-sized pieces. Heat a pot over medium heat with sesame oil. Add kimchi and stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add anchovy broth or vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Add gochugaru and simmer for 10 minutes. Add tofu cubes, shiitake mushrooms, and sliced zucchini. Simmer for another 8 minutes. Season with soy sauce and fish sauce. Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
ingredients: 3 cups anchovy broth or vegetable broth

name: Korean Kimchi Stew
description: Hearty stew with kimchi, tofu, pork, and vegetables
instructions: Cut kimchi into bite-sized pieces. Slice pork belly thinly. Drain and cut tofu into cubes. Heat a pot over medium heat, add sesame oil and pork. Cook pork until fat renders (5 minutes). Add garlic and kimchi, stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add kimchi juice, water or anchovy broth, and gochugaru (Korean chili flakes). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 15 minutes to develop flavors. Add tofu cubes, zucchini, and green onions. Simmer for another 10 minutes. Season with fish sauce if needed. Serve hot in a bowl, garnished with green onions.

name: Korean Samgyetang
description: Ginseng chicken soup with rice stuffing
instructions: Stuff chicken with sweet rice, garlic, and ginseng. Simmer in broth with jujubes and ginger until chicken is tender.

name: Korean Sesame Chicken
description: Crispy chicken in savory sesame-garlic sauce with vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Toss chicken in cornstarch and salt, shaking off excess. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry chicken in batches until golden and cooked through (4-5 minutes). Remove chicken and set aside. In the same pan, sauté sliced bell peppers and onions for 2 minutes. Add minced garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, and vinegar. Simmer for 1 minute until sauce thickens slightly. Return chicken to pan and toss to coat evenly. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Korean Spicy Beef Stew
description: Slow-cooked beef stew with Korean chili flakes, vegetables, and glass noodles
instructions: Cut beef into 1-inch cubes. Soak glass noodles in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain. Heat a large pot over medium-high heat with sesame oil. Add beef cubes and brown on all sides (5 minutes). Add onion, garlic, and ginger, sautéing for 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, gochugaru, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 1 hour until beef is tender. Add potatoes, carrots, radish, and glass noodles. Simmer for another 20 minutes until vegetables are cooked. Add green onions and serve hot.

name: Korean Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
description: Marinated chicken thighs in sweet-spicy sauce with grilled vegetables
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil to make marinade. Add chicken to marinade, ensuring pieces are well coated. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (up to 2 hours for better flavor). Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with oil. Add chicken and cook for 6-8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add sliced bell peppers and onions, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with steamed rice.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint
description: Grilled lamb chops with mint sauce and roasted vegetables
instructions: Grill lamb chops. Make mint sauce. Serve with roasted vegetables.

name: Lamb Rack with Herb Crust
description: Rack of lamb with crusty herb coating
instructions: Sear rack of lamb. Coat with herb and breadcrumb mixture. Roast at 400°F for 15-18 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Lean Beef Stir-Fry
description: Lean beef strips with colorful vegetables in brown rice
instructions: Stir-fry beef with vegetables, add sauce and serve over brown rice.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Cod
description: Flaky cod baked with lemon, herbs, and served with asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat 6 oz cod fillets dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper. Place cod on a parchment-lined baking sheet. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tsp dried thyme, and 2 cloves minced garlic. Brush mixture over cod fillets. Arrange 1 cup asparagus spears around fish on the baking sheet, drizzling with remaining oil mixture. Bake for 12-15 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily, and asparagus is tender-crisp. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Juicy grilled chicken with bright lemon and herbs
instructions: In a bowl, mix 1/4 cup olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 2 cloves minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Add 4 chicken breasts and marinate for at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours). Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with grilled vegetables and a side of quinoa.

name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
description: Whole roasted chicken with lemon and fresh herbs
instructions: Rub chicken with butter, lemon, garlic, and herbs. Roast at 375°F for 1.5 hours until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Let rest 15 minutes before carving.

name: Lobster Thermidor
description: Classic French lobster in creamy wine sauce
instructions: Cook lobster and remove meat. Make sauce with wine, cream, and cheese. Mix with meat. Fill shells. Top with cheese and broil.

name: Malaysian Laksa with Prawns
description: Spicy coconut noodle soup with seafood
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot and sauté 2 tbsp laksa paste for 1 minute. Add 4 cups chicken broth, 1 can coconut milk, and 1 tbsp fish sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add 8 prawns, 4 oz fish cake, and 200g rice noodles. Cook for 5 minutes until prawns are pink. Serve in bowls topped with bean sprouts, mint, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Roast
description: Roasted chicken with Mediterranean vegetables and olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut vegetables into large chunks: zucchini, bell peppers, red onion, and cherry tomatoes. Toss vegetables with 3 tablespoons olive oil, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Spread on a large baking sheet in a single layer. Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and a little olive oil. Arrange chicken on top of vegetables. Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning chicken halfway through, until skin is crispy and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Squeeze fresh lemon over chicken and vegetables. Serve with crusty bread or over quinoa.

name: Mexican Mole Negro
description: Oaxacan black mole with chicken
instructions: Make complex black mole with chiles, chocolate, spices, and nuts. Simmer chicken in mole until cooked through. Serve with rice and tortillas.

name: Mexican Mole Poblano Chicken
description: Chicken in rich chocolate-chile mole sauce
instructions: Prepare complex mole sauce with chiles, chocolate, spices, and nuts. Simmer chicken in mole until cooked through. Serve with rice and warm tortillas.

name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemons
description: Slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemons and olives
instructions: Brown chicken in tagine pot. Add onions, garlic, spices, preserved lemons, and olives. Simmer slowly until chicken is tender.

name: Moroccan Lamb Couscous
description: Seven-vegetable couscous with slow-cooked lamb
instructions: Slow cook lamb with seven vegetables and spices. Steam couscous until fluffy. Serve lamb and vegetables over couscous with harissa.

name: Moroccan Lamb Tagine with Prunes
description: Slow-cooked lamb with sweet prunes and almonds
instructions: Brown lamb pieces. Add onions, spices, and cinnamon. Add water and prunes. Simmer slowly for 2-3 hours. Top with toasted almonds and sesame seeds.

name: Moussaka
description: Greek layered casserole with eggplant, meat sauce, and béchamel
instructions: Layer eggplant with meat sauce. Top with béchamel and bake until golden.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add 2 cups sliced mushrooms and cook until golden and tender (5-7 minutes). Add 1 cup arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until grains are coated and translucent. Add 1/2 cup white wine and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed. Begin adding 4 cups warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. Continue for 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente. Remove from heat and stir in 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese and 2 tbsp butter. Season with salt and pepper. Let rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Paella
description: Spanish rice dish with seafood, chicken, and saffron
instructions: Sauté seafood and chicken. Add rice and saffron-infused broth. Simmer until rice is tender.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
description: Spicy tomato pasta with garlic and chili peppers
instructions: Cook penne. Sauté garlic and chili in olive oil. Add tomatoes and simmer. Toss with pasta.

name: Persian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled ground lamb kebabs with saffron rice
instructions: Mix ground lamb with onion, spices, and saffron. Form onto skewers. Grill over charcoal until charred. Serve with saffron rice and grilled tomatoes.

name: Peruvian Ceviche with Sweet Potato
description: Fresh fish cured in citrus with Peruvian sides
instructions: Cut fresh white fish into cubes. Marinate in lime juice with chiles, onions, and cilantro until opaque. Serve with sweet potato, corn, and canchita.

name: Pork Chops with Apples
description: Pan-seared pork chops with caramelized apples and onions
instructions: Season and sear pork chops. Caramelize apples and onions. Serve together.

name: Pork Fried Rice
description: Fried rice with pork, eggs, and mixed vegetables
instructions: Stir-fry pork with vegetables. Add rice and eggs. Season with soy sauce.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze
description: Roasted pork tenderloin with sweet apple glaze
instructions: Season pork and sear on all sides. Roast at 400°F for 20-25 minutes. Make glaze with apple cider and maple syrup. Brush on pork and serve.

name: Portuguese Francesinha Sandwich
description: Porto's famous sandwich with multiple meats and spicy sauce
instructions: Butter 2 thick slices of brioche bread. Layer with 2 slices ham, 2 slices steak, 2 slices linguiça sausage, and 2 slices cheese. Top with second bread slice. In a saucepan, heat 1 cup beer, 1/4 cup tomato sauce, 1 bay leaf, and 1 tsp hot sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes. Place sandwich in a baking dish, pour sauce over, top with more cheese, and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until bubbly. Serve with fried potatoes.

name: Ratatouille
description: French vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, and tomatoes
instructions: Layer sliced vegetables and bake with herbs until tender. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Salmon Kimchi Bowl
description: Omega-3 rich salmon paired with probiotic kimchi and vegetables
instructions: Season salmon fillets with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Pan-sear salmon over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Rest for 2 minutes, then flake into large chunks. In a bowl, layer steamed brown rice, flaked salmon, kimchi, sliced cucumber, and avocado. Drizzle with spicy mayo (mayonnaise mixed with sriracha). Sprinkle sesame seeds and nori strips on top. Serve immediately while salmon is warm.

name: Salmon with Ginger and Turmeric
description: Omega-rich baked salmon with anti-inflammatory ginger and turmeric glaze
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix olive oil, grated ginger, turmeric, garlic, lemon juice, honey, and soy sauce in a small bowl to make glaze. Place salmon fillets on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush each fillet generously with glaze. Arrange asparagus and cherry tomatoes around salmon. Season vegetables with salt and pepper. Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with brown rice or quinoa.

name: Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
description: Omega-rich salmon with fiber-packed roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat salmon fillets dry and season with salt, pepper, olive oil, herbs, and garlic. Place broccoli florets and cubed sweet potato on a baking sheet. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange salmon on top. Bake for 15-20 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork, and vegetables are tender. Squeeze fresh lemon over the dish before serving.

name: Seafood Paella
description: Spanish rice dish with mixed seafood and saffron
instructions: Sauté chorizo and seafood. Add bomba rice and saffron. Cook in broth until rice is done. Let rest covered for 5 minutes. Serve with lemon.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Ground meat and vegetable filling topped with mashed potatoes
instructions: Cook meat with vegetables. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake until golden.

name: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, eggs, and peanut sauce
instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry shrimp and vegetables. Add noodles and sauce. Toss with peanuts.

name: Shrimp Scampi with Linguine
description: Garlic butter shrimp over al dente linguine
instructions: Cook linguine to al dente. Sauté garlic in butter until fragrant. Add shrimp and cook until pink. Add wine and lemon. Toss with pasta and parsley.

name: Sichuan Mapo Tofu
description: Spicy Sichuan tofu with ground pork
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Add 2 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add 4 oz ground pork and cook until browned. Add 2 tbsp doubanjiang (chili bean paste) and cook for 1 minute. Add 1 block firm tofu (cubed), 1 cup chicken broth, and 1 tsp soy sauce. Simmer for 5 minutes. Thicken with 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water. Garnish with Sichuan peppercorns and green onions.

name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
description: Classic Italian pasta with homemade meatballs and marinara sauce
instructions: Cook pasta. Brown meatballs and simmer in marinara sauce. Serve with parmesan cheese.

name: Spanish Cochinillo Asado
description: Roast suckling pig with crackling skin
instructions: Season suckling pig with salt and herbs. Roast at 400°F until skin is crackling and meat is tender. Rest before carving.

name: Spanish Paella Mixta
description: Valencian paella with chicken, rabbit, and seafood
instructions: Sauté meats and seafood. Add bomba rice and saffron-infused broth. Cook uncovered until rice forms socarrat crust. Let rest before serving.

name: Steak and Potatoes
description: Grilled steak with roasted potatoes and asparagus
instructions: Grill steak to desired doneness. Roast potatoes and asparagus with herbs.

name: Swiss Fondue Feast
description: Melty cheese fondue with crusty bread and vegetables
instructions: Combine Gruyère, Emmental, and wine in pot. Melt with garlic and nutmeg. Serve hot with crusty bread, potatoes, and pickles for dipping.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Spicy coconut curry with vegetables and your choice of protein
instructions: Sauté curry paste. Add coconut milk and vegetables. Simmer with protein. Serve with rice.

name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
description: Spicy Thai curry with chicken and vegetables
instructions: Fry curry paste in coconut milk. Add chicken and vegetables. Simmer until chicken is cooked. Finish with Thai basil and lime juice.

name: Thai Green Curry Rot Duck
description: Spicy green curry with roasted duck
instructions: Roast duck until skin is crispy. Make green curry paste with chiles and herbs. Simmer duck in coconut curry with vegetables.

name: Thai Massaman Curry with Beef
description: Rich curry with beef, potatoes, and peanuts
instructions: Braise beef in coconut milk with massaman curry paste. Add potatoes and onions. Simmer until beef is tender. Finish with peanuts.

name: Turkish Adana Kebab with Bulgur
description: Spiced ground lamb skewers over bulgur pilaf
instructions: Mix lamb with spices and form onto skewers. Grill over charcoal until charred. Serve with bulgur pilaf, grilled vegetables, and cacık.

name: Turkish Hunkar Begendi
description: Stewed beef over smoked eggplant purée
instructions: Roast and purée eggplant. Make creamy bechamel with cheese. Stew beef in tomato sauce. Pour beef over eggplant purée.

name: Turkish Manti Dumplings
description: Spiced meat-filled dumplings with yogurt sauce
instructions: Fill small dough squares with spiced meat. Pinch closed. Boil until they float. Serve with garlic yogurt sauce and browned butter.

name: Tuscan Bistecca alla Fiorentina
description: Grilled T-bone steak with rosemary and garlic
instructions: Season thick T-bone generously with salt. Grill over high heat to medium-rare. Finish with rosemary and garlic butter. Let rest before slicing.

name: Vegetable Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai stir-fried noodles with vegetables
instructions: Soak 8 oz rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain. Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, snap peas) and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. Push vegetables to side, add 2 beaten eggs and scramble. Add drained noodles and sauce mixture (3 tbsp fish sauce, 2 tbsp tamarind paste, 1 tbsp sugar). Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes. Serve with bean sprouts, crushed peanuts, and lime wedges.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Mixed vegetables stir-fried with tofu and ginger sauce
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables and tofu. Add ginger-soy sauce. Serve over rice.

name: Vegetarian Chili
description: Hearty three-bean chili with vegetables and spices
instructions: Sauté vegetables and beans. Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer for 1 hour. Top with cheese.

name: Vegetarian Moussaka
description: Layered eggplant and potato casserole with béchamel
instructions: Layer sliced eggplant and potato with tomato sauce. Top with creamy béchamel sauce. Bake at 350°F for 45-50 minutes until golden and bubbly.

name: Vietnamese Pho Bo
description: Classic beef noodle soup with aromatic broth
instructions: Simmer beef bones with charred aromatics and spices for 6-8 hours. Serve with rice noodles, rare beef, herbs, and bean sprouts.

name: Andalusian Gazpacho
description: Cold Spanish tomato soup with vegetables and olive oil
instructions: In a blender, combine 2 lbs ripe tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1/2 red bell pepper, 1/2 green bell pepper, 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 2 cloves garlic, and 1/4 cup olive oil. Blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve for extra smooth texture. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve cold in bowls, garnished with diced cucumber, bell pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Crispy lettuce cups filled with seasoned chicken and vegetables
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 6 oz ground chicken and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned (5-6 minutes). Add 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger, and 1/4 cup diced water chestnuts. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp honey. Add sauce to chicken and stir until coated. Remove from heat and stir in 2 sliced green onions and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro. Spoon mixture into butter lettuce cups and serve immediately.

name: Asian Sesame Chicken Bowl
description: Grilled chicken with sesame ginger sauce over jasmine rice
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked through. Prepare jasmine rice. Toss chicken in sesame ginger sauce. Serve over rice with steamed broccoli and carrots.

name: Australian Chicken Parma Wrap
description: Chicken schnitzel with tomato sauce and cheese in a wrap
instructions: Bread and fry chicken schnitzel. Top with tomato sauce and cheese until melted. Wrap in a tortilla with lettuce and chips.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwich
description: Tender BBQ chicken on a brioche bun with coleslaw
instructions: Slow cook chicken in BBQ sauce until tender. Toast brioche buns. Assemble sandwiches with pulled chicken, coleslaw, and pickles.

name: BLT Sandwich
description: Classic bacon, lettuce, and tomato on whole grain toast
instructions: Cook bacon until crispy. Toast bread and assemble with lettuce, tomato, and mayo.

name: Beef and Bell Pepper Skillet
description: Quick and colorful beef skillet with bell peppers and jasmine rice
instructions: Slice beef thinly against the grain. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Add sliced bell peppers (red, yellow, orange for color) and diced onion. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon turmeric. Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return beef to the skillet. Pour in sauce mixture (3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce, and 1 tablespoon sesame oil). Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until beef and vegetables are evenly coated. Remove from heat. Meanwhile, cook jasmine rice according to package directions. Divide rice into bowls. Top with beef and bell pepper mixture. Sprinkle with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Serve immediately.
ingredients: 6 oz beef sirloin or flank steak

name: Beef and Broccoli Rice Bowl
description: Quick ground beef bowl with broccoli and jasmine rice
instructions: Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (5-6 minutes). Add minced garlic and grated ginger, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add broccoli florets and sliced carrots. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are bright green but still crisp. Mix sauce ingredients: soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and 1/2 teaspoon honey. Pour sauce over beef and vegetables, tossing to coat evenly. Cook for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Divide cooked jasmine rice into bowls. Top with beef and vegetable mixture. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. Serve immediately.

name: Beef and Vegetable Wraps
description: Healthy wraps with seasoned ground beef and fresh vegetables
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6 minutes). Drain excess fat if needed.
